To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) CapsGAN performs better or equal to CNN based GAN in generating images with geometrical transformations, and 2) Wasserstein distance with gradient clipping and penalty and Spectral Normalized GANs are more stable and perform better than traditional GANs.
we have proposed CapsGAN which uses dynamic routing to generate 2D images in the MNIST domain and that it performs better than or at least equal to traditional CNNs in the domain.

(i) Capsules can be successfully applied to the GANs problem space, (ii) CapsGAN outperforms CNN based GAN models in generating 2D images with high geometrical transformations, and (iii) Spectral Normalization is a better alternative than Gradient Penalties in training GAN models.

the application of Capsule networks in the domain of GANs.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CapsGAN performs on par with or better than traditional CNN based GAs in the generation of images with high geometric transformation.
CapsGAN is a promising technique for generating images with geometric transformations.
CapsGAN is a novel approach for generating images in 3D domain with high degree of geometric transformations using rotated and translated MNIST images.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CapsGAN is a novel technique that uses CapsNet to improve the generation quality of GANs.
we have demonstrated the efficacy of Capsules in GANs, and the efficacy of GANs in 3D image (and video) generation.

CapsGANs are able to generate images in the 2D and 3D domain that are of better quality and have higher degree of transformations than CNN based GAN models, while maintaining the training stability of GANs and the performance control of Wasserstein distance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CapsGAN is an effective tool for image generation in the 3d domain, and can be applied to the generation of videos (frames).
CapsGAN can be used to generate 3D images and that the use of capsules architecture in the domain of image generation is a viable and promising approach.
the use of capsules in GANs improves the quality of generated images with high degree geometrical transformations.
